files.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml b/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml
index b64e1e4..669d074 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish-pr-state.yml
@@ -2,130 +2,129 @@ name: Publish Live Remediation PR State
 
 on:
   pull_request:
     types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, closed]
   workflow_dispatch:
 
 permissions:
   contents: write
   pull-requests: read
   pages: write
   id-token: write
 
 concurrency:
   group: pages
   cancel-in-progress: false
 
 jobs:
   publish-pr-state:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     environment:
       name: github-pages
       url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
     steps:
       - name: Checkout main
         uses: actions/checkout@v4
         with:
           ref: main
           fetch-depth: 1
 
       - name: Update live remediation PR metadata
         env:
           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
           PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
           PR_STATE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.state }}
           PR_MERGED: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merged }}
           PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
           PR_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
           PR_URL: ${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}
           PR_CREATED: ${{ github.event.pull_request.created_at }}
           PR_UPDATED: ${{ github.event.pull_request.updated_at }}
           PR_MERGED_AT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merged_at }}
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           python3 - <<'PY'
           import json, os
           from pathlib import Path
 
           number = os.environ.get("PR_NUMBER", "").strip()
           if not number:
               print("No pull-request event payload; nothing to publish.")
               raise SystemExit(0)
 
           head = os.environ.get("PR_HEAD", "")
           if not (head.startswith("security-remediation/") or head.startswith("security/ai-remediation/")):
               print(f"Ignoring non-remediation PR: {head}")
               raise SystemExit(0)
 
           latest_path = Path("data/latest.json")
           latest = json.loads(latest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
           current = latest.get("pull_requests", [])
           current = [p for p in current if str(p.get("number")) != number]
 
           current.append({
               "number": int(number),
               "title": os.environ.get("PR_TITLE", ""),
               "state": os.environ.get("PR_STATE", ""),
               "merged": os.environ.get("PR_MERGED", "").lower() == "true",
               "head": head,
               "base": os.environ.get("PR_BASE", "main"),
               "url": os.environ.get("PR_URL", ""),
               "created_at": os.environ.get("PR_CREATED", ""),
               "updated_at": os.environ.get("PR_UPDATED", ""),
               "merged_at": os.environ.get("PR_MERGED_AT") or None,
           })
           current.sort(key=lambda p: p["number"], reverse=True)
 
           latest["pull_requests"] = current
           latest_path.write_text(
               json.dumps(latest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
           )
-          Path("data/flow.json").write_text(json.dumps(latest.get("flow", {}), indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
           Path("data/pull-requests.json").write_text(
               json.dumps(current, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
           )
           print(json.dumps(current, indent=2))
           PY
 
       - name: Commit live PR state
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
           git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
           git add data/pull-requests.json data/latest.json
           if git diff --cached --quiet; then
             echo "No PR state changes."
             exit 0
           fi
           git commit -m "chore: publish live remediation PR state [skip ci]"
           git push origin HEAD:main
 
       - name: Build isolated Pages site
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           rm -rf .pages
           mkdir -p .pages/data/scans
           cp index.html .pages/index.html
           cp flow.html .pages/flow.html
           cp data/latest.json .pages/data/latest.json
           cp data/index.json .pages/data/index.json
           cp data/pull-requests.json .pages/data/pull-requests.json
           cp data/flow.json .pages/data/flow.json
           cp -R data/scans/. .pages/data/scans/
           cat > .pages/deployment.json <<EOF
           {
             "deployed_at": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
             "workflow_run": "${{ github.run_id }}"
           }
           EOF
 
       - name: Configure GitHub Pages
         uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
 
       - name: Upload Pages artifact
         uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
         with:
           path: .pages
 
       - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
         id: deployment
         uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
